headline: HLA-DR3のRo60ペプチドは、TCRに3残基を見せる
subhead: 自己抗原ペプチドとの結晶構造（2.87 Å）。Treg療法の設計の手がかりになる

summary.question: HLA-DR3がRo60ペプチドを提示する構造は、CLIPペプチドのもの以外なかった。
summary.approach: Ro60ペプチドを結合したHLA-DR3の結晶構造を決め、Ro60反応性TCRを導入したTregも作った。
summary.result: Ro60ペプチドは標準的な向きで結合し、P2・P5・P8の3残基がTCR側に露出していた。
summary.learned: Ro60反応性TCRを導入したTregは、自己反応性T細胞を通常のTregより効果的に抑えた。
summary.open: 導入したTregの性質と安定性を、さまざまな条件で調べることが今後の課題とされる。

question.quote: yet no structural data currently exist for Ro60 peptide presentation by this allele beyond the invariant CLIP peptide structure

approach.quote: Using this optimized platform, we determined the crystal structure of HLA-DR3 bound to the immunodominant Ro60369–383 peptide (PDB 9YZ3) at 2.87 Å resolution (R_work 23.7%, R_free 29.9%).

We designed a TCR-Treg that recognizes a dominant epitope of the Ro60 antigen (Ro60369-383) presented by HLA-DRB1∗03:01 and demonstrate that these cells can selectively suppress autoreactive T cells more effectively than polyclonal Treg.

result.quote: In the resulting structure, the Ro60369–383 peptide adopts a canonical register, with the 9-mer binding core defined as FLLAVDVSA.
Three residues: P2-Leucine, P5-Valine, and P8-Serine were solvent-exposed and positioned for TCR recognition (Figure 3).

learned.quote: We designed a TCR-Treg that recognizes a dominant epitope of the Ro60 antigen (Ro60369-383) presented by HLA-DRB1∗03:01 and demonstrate that these cells can selectively suppress autoreactive T cells more effectively than polyclonal Treg.

open.quote: Future studies will therefore focus on systematically evaluating the phenotype and stability of the engineered Treg across these settings.

highlights.text: HLA-DR3に自己抗原ペプチドが結合した初の構造だと著者は述べる。これまではCLIP複合体に限られていた。分解能は2.87 Åで、Rfreeは29.9%とやや高い。

evidence.quote: Notably, this is the first structure of HLA-DR3 bound to an autoantigenic peptide, as previous structural data have been limited to complexes with CLIP peptides.
the Ro60369–383 peptide adopts a canonical register, with the 9-mer binding core defined as FLLAVDVSA.

highlights.text: HLA-DR3は発現収量が低く、Ro60ペプチドの直接発現は約0.3 mg/Lだった。CLIPのポケット4をAspにした変異（P4D）で約11 mg/Lに上がり、熱安定性も改善したため、ペプチド交換で結晶化に必要な量を確保できた。

evidence.quote: Substituting aspartic acid at Pocket 4 from alanine (P4D) or lysine at Pocket 6 from proline (P6K) markedly improved yields, with CLIP_P6K reaching ∼1.3 mg/L and CLIP_P4D achieving ∼11 mg/L

These findings demonstrate that rationally designed point mutations can enhance the stability and expression of soluble HLA-DR3, enabling structural characterization of low-yield peptide-MHC complexes.

highlights.text: この構造は、Ro60に反応するTCRを導入したTreg療法の設計根拠になる。患者TregにこのTCRを導入するとin vitroで抑制能が約2倍になったが、in vivoの検証は今後の課題だ。

evidence.quote: Importantly, Ro60-Treg exhibited approximately 2-fold enhanced suppression of Ro60-driven inflammatory responses compared with non-engineered Treg
extending these findings into in vivo models will be an important next step to further validate functional efficacy

lab_notes.expression: Expi293 GnTI⁻細胞で一過性発現（PEI）。培養7日後に上清を回収。
lab_notes.construct: α鎖・β鎖の細胞外領域をFos/Junジッパーで二量化。β鎖N末端にペプチドを共有結合（CLIP変異体）。
lab_notes.purification: HisTrap → サイズ排除。Factor Xaで切断後、Ro60 369–383を20倍モルで37°C・72時間交換、StrepTactinで未交換体を除去。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 4 mg/mL。0.2 M マロン酸ナトリウム、20% PEG 3350で結晶化。20%グリセロールで凍結保護。
lab_notes.data_collection: オーストラリア・シンクロトロンMX2。XDS/Aimlessで処理、PDB 1A6Aで分子置換。

evidence.quote: The recombinant HLA-DR3 with a covalently linked peptide was transiently expressed in Expi293 GnTI− cells (ThermoFisher) using Polyethylene
Synthetic Ro60369-383 peptide (GL Biochem) was added at a 20:1 M ratio and incubated with HLA-DR3 at 37 °C for 72 h to enable peptide exchange.
Crystals of HLA-DR3-Ro60369-383 were obtained in 0.2M of sodium malon salt and 20%w/v polyethylene glycol (PEG) 3350.
Molecular replacement was performed in PhaserMR (CCP4) using the coordinates of PDB entry 1A6A as the search model.

editor_notes: 構造は論文の一部（機能試験が中心）。『HLA-DR3に自己抗原が結合した初の構造』は著者の主張で、独自には確認していない。構造図はPDB 9YZ3。
